item.title: It’s a quiet box office weekend as ‘GOAT’ edges ‘Wuthering Heights’
item.description: It was a battle of the holdovers at the North American box office this weekend, with the family friendly film “GOAT” edging out the R-rated “Wuthering Heights.”

item.title: PennDOT sets road restrictions ahead of winter storm
item.description: With a snowstorm impacting Northeast Pennsylvania Sunday into Monday, the Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) and the Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission (PA Turnpike) are implementing vehicle restrictions on Interstates and the PA Turnpike.

item.title: Area pop culture fans attend final day of NEPA Comic Con
item.description: DICKSON CITY — Fans of everything from Star Wars to Scooby-Doo gathered at the Moon Ballroom in Dickson City on Sunday for the final day of NEPA Comic Con.

item.title: Armed man shot and killed after entering secure perimeter of Mar-a-Lago, Secret Service says
item.description: WASHINGTON — An armed man drove into the secure perimeter of Mar-a-Lago, President Donald Trump’s resort in Palm Beach, Florida, before being shot and killed early Sunday morning, according to a spokesman for the U.S. Secret Service. Trump was not there but was at the White House in Washington.

item.title: After 4 years of war by Russia in Ukraine, peace is still elusive despite a US push for a settlement
item.description: When Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine surpassed 1,418 days last month, it officially exceeded a historic milestone — the same span of time it took Moscow to defeat Nazi Germany in World War II.

item.title: EU says US must honor a trade deal after court blocks Trump tariffs
item.description: BRUSSELS — The European Union’s executive arm requested “full clarity” from the United States and asked its trade partner to fulfill its commitments after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down some of President Donald Trump’s most sweeping tariffs.

item.title: LEGISLATIVE ROUNDUP: Officials highlight new, regional teams designed to protect older adults from abuse
item.description: Pennsylvania Department of Aging Secretary Jason Kavulich this week touted how regional teams created under the Shapiro Administration and backed by the U.S. Department of Justice will help keep older Pennsylvanians safe and protected from abuse.

item.title: BEYOND THE BYLINE: A meaningful Lenten suggestion
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — For Catholics, Lent is a time for reflection and adjustment.

item.title: Luzerne County adds 24 new workers in January
item.description: Luzerne County government added 24 new employees in January, while four prior workers were rehired, according to the latest monthly personnel report.
